of the criminal justice system, name-ly police, prisons, prosecutors/lawyers, judicial 
officers & forensic experts, in understanding and implementing the new criminal 
laws, that is, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,

Section 152 ‘ Act endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India’ is a new offence 
introduced  in BNS.   
• This offence has been introduced to protect the State instead of the 
Government established by  law.   
• It penalizes an individual who:  
-   Purposely or knowingly  
• Using means such as:

• words, either spoken or written, or by signs, or by visible representation,

• Excites or attempts

• words, either spoken or written, or by signs, or by visible representation, 
or by  electronic communication or by use of financial mean, or otherwise
• Excites or attempts to excite: 
-   secession,   
-   armed rebellion,   
-   subversive and separatist activities,  
-   acts endangering sovereignty or unity and integrity of India.
